# speckit missing

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

The unified missing feed (feature 035, ADR-0056): one ranked, deterministic list of every outstanding item across all thirteen advisory families, each carrying first literal `run` next step

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit missing [OPTIONS]
```

`--json` prints one JSON object enabled stdout.
